entry_points.text: Tag insertion validates length and returns packet for transmit; event helpers forward key and sync reports to dispatch.
Cancellation needs ring state and fork needs restriction; span helpers detect crossing; gather widens ranges before sync.
Iteration dispatches by kind with clamping; sockets offer gated lookup; versions offer stores and increments.
Journal feature helpers test support; identifiers order by signed difference; handles allocate from caches.

exports.text: I2C checks gate capability bits and form wire octets with driver binding; firmware lookups are absent when disabled, delegated when enabled.
VLAN acceleration stores protocol and tag; discovery resolves stacked tags; insert expands head and moves addresses; removal strips the tag.
ICMPv6 header derives from transport offset; sends forward when enabled else no-op with error classification; IPv4 helpers test address ranges.
Disabled integrity hooks return absent; indirect calls compare known targets then fall back; input refs delegate; access checks validate ranges.
Fallback remaps succeed idly; command completion forwards status and width; user copies validate tags, prefixes, and lengths.
Memory copies branch on discriminator without bounds check; step callbacks report remainder; IP headers derive from offsets; journal types alias.

hazards.text: Linearity may reallocate and fails on over-length; copy expands shared heads; stripping assumes offset with multi-tag fail-closed; wide access can tear; commit peeks stale.
Remap modes, command cancel bits, request linkage flags, and ring file flags use fixed assignments.
Protection, domain, and resource bits use fixed values; sleeping poll forbids atomic context; allocation excludes flush; fault perms fixed.

invariants.text: VLAN device test checks private flag with absent tag report and narrowed offloads; network dispatch selects optimized indirect form.
Touch active means tracked with incrementing identifiers; integrity detects change from saved identity; vendor lookup recovers container.
Return addresses use local labels; scopes emit annotations or nothing; atomic checks warn on misalignment then validate accesses.
Sixty-four-bit port access synthesizes low then high halves as non-atomic; command payload access stays within entry budgets.
Resources use inclusive bounds with type-masked containment and overlap; priority packs class and level with validity range.
Mappings pair pointer with discriminator for equality and null tests; IP lengths use network order with fallbacks and maxima.

locks.text: Bus lock and unlock forward scope to adapter handler; root and segment occupy distinct low bits.
Filter reference acquisition requires routing lock; egress lookup runs under read-side section with single-load match.
Input events use spinlock and filters use spinlock with copy-on-write; journal head uses paired bit spin; array iteration holds read section.

state_machines.text: Suspend flag asserts and clears only under root lock; tags live inline or accelerated with predicate separating tagged from untagged.
Handlers attach on match and connect open handles with optional exclusive grab, deliver events, then disconnect.
Iterators consume bounded pieces and advance progress; transactions move from running through flush to finished on journal thread.

structs.text: Wire tag with private tables; tag four bytes with four thousand identifiers; diagnostic handler and textual address limits fixed.
Input handles link devices with force-feedback ops and touch slots with track bound; integrity snapshot and vendor device link firmware and regions.
Timer mode, IP maximum, journal magic, feature and control flags, and buffer queue identifiers use fixed numeric assignments.
Commands hold file, entry, and thirty-two-byte area; descriptors overlay opcode with completion; rings pair counters with masks.
Work items chain nodes with flags; file tables use arrays; queue state pairs queue and owner; domains hold ops and geometry.
Faults pair type with flags and address; gather holds intervals; resources hold bounds and tree; invalid identifier uses all bits.
Device config holds forwarding controls with socket addresses; journal header and state hold flags, locks, queues, and progress.
